task: Three strategy variants for the same 8-test Python agent task

methodology.branchpoint_shared_prefix: One exploration trajectory, disk snapshot, reuse the prefix devbox for one continuation, and create N-1 forks; all continuations reuse the exact LLM transcript prefix.
methodology.one_sandbox_sequential: One devbox runs three complete trajectories sequentially, resetting the task files before each trajectory.
methodology.n_sandboxes_fanout: Three devboxes run three complete trajectories concurrently from the same task-ready disk snapshot.
methodology.cache_isolation: A fresh random nonce is embedded in the cacheable system prefix immediately before every condition. Cache reuse is therefore possible only within that condition.
methodology.cache_policy: Anthropic explicit ephemeral prompt cache (5-minute TTL), sticky OpenRouter session per condition, whole-response cache disabled.
methodology.sandbox_time: Sum of Runloop /devboxes/{id}/usage total_active_seconds after every condition devbox is shut down.
methodology.llm_cost: OpenRouter usage.cost when directly billed; provider upstream_inference_cost for this BYOK run. Prompt-cache read/write pricing is reflected.
methodology.wall_time: Primary wall time is condition start to the final test verdict; terminal wall through final shutdown is also stored.
methodology.fixture_exclusion: The common task-ready fixture snapshot is prepared once and excluded from all three conditions.

aggregation_note: Five controlled trials; method order alternated. Values are arithmetic means with observed min/max. Every method passed all three 8-test branches in every trial.
